title: OpenAI directs 80–90% of research toward GPT-7 and beyond
teaser: OpenAI is directing 80–90% of its research toward GPT-7 and later models, according to Power. The allocation reflects a bet that the biggest gains come from new generations, which can improve more than the model itself. It also leaves a smaller share for near-term changes to existing versions—work OpenAI sees as useful for fast iteration, but potentially too short-sighted to drive the next major step.
